discrepancies.title: V11 audit missed a LIVE second not-found path in internal/loader (LDR001 + suggestSimilar)
discrepancies.finding: The doc's systemic audit (V11) only checked the DEAD internal/module siblings. There is a SECOND live not-found path in the SAME package M3 edits: internal/loader/loader.go:202 and :251 call newLDR001 (loader_errors.go:52) with ml.suggestSimilar(path) (loader_errors.go:92) — a structured LDR001 error that ALREADY carries a `similar[]` suggestion. Verified via grep + caller trace.
discrepancies.why_scope_still_holds: LDR001/suggestSimilar fires ONLY for non-stdlib (project/package/self) imports — the code branches on `strings.HasPrefix(canonPath, "std/")` at loader.go before the stdlib resolver. The `std/time → std/clock` trap is exclusively the stdlib branch (errWithSearchTrace), which is M3's exact target and has NO suggestion today. LDR001 is a different case with its own (heuristic) suggestion. So M3's single-site scope is CORRECT; the doc's V11 phrasing (“ONE suggestion engine” / “live path is exactly one”) is imprecise but its conclusion (edit only errWithSearchTrace) is right.
discrepancies.action: Executor: record this in the PR body's systemic-audit note (there are TWO live not-found paths; M3 owns the stdlib one; LDR001/suggestSimilar for local modules is intentionally out of scope and already has a suggestion). Do NOT expand scope to unify them — that is a separate follow-up if ever desired.

features.description: `ailang docs --all-functions [filter]`: one deterministic, grep-able line per stdlib export (module.func: sig ! effects -- description), signatures rendered from the AST (fixing the V16 effect-row truncation in per-module docs too). Optional positional case-insensitive filter over the full rendered line.

implementation.flag: Add `allFunctionsFlag := docsFlags.Bool("all-functions", false, ...)` to the flag set at cmd/ailang/docs.go:44-47. Handle it AFTER findStdlibDir (docs.go:60) and BEFORE the --list branch. The trailing positional (docsFlags.Arg(0)) is the optional case-insensitive filter.
implementation.signature_rendering: New shared helper: for each std/*.ail, parse with lexer.New + parser.New + Parse() (same API as debug.go:183-185 / test.go:97-98), walk prog.File.Funcs, keep IsExport==true. Render `name[T1,T2](p1type, p2type) -> rettype ! {Eff}` from FuncDecl fields: TypeParams (bracketed if non-empty), Params[].Type.String(), ReturnType.String(), ast.FormatEffects(Effects). This REPLACES the exportSigRe regex path for signatures in BOTH --all-functions AND showModuleDocs (docs.go:306 formatExportSignature). The `-- description` prose still comes from the doc-comment scan (AST carries no comments) — keep parseModuleFile's DocLine collection for prose only.
implementation.output_line: `std/clock.now: () -> int ! {Clock} -- Returns epoch time...`. Modules sorted (discoverModules already sorts, docs.go:163); exports in FILE order (FuncDecl order as parsed).
implementation.prelude_pseudo_module: Prepend `prelude.` entries sourced from the M4 renderer (println/show + implicit option/result note). Reuse M4's shared prelude-surface accessor so there is ONE prelude source of truth. If M4 lands first, import its helper; if M1 lands first, the executor may stub prelude entries and wire them when M4 lands (same PR).
implementation.filter: If a positional filter arg is present, keep only lines whose lowercased FULL rendered line (module path + name + signature + description) contains the lowercased filter. Case-insensitive substring, no regex.
implementation.failure_mode: A std/*.ail that does not parse → print the file name to stderr and exit non-zero (stdlib always parsing is CI's contract). NEVER drop or partial-render a row silently.
implementation.path_resolution: Reuse findStdlibDir (docs.go:85) — no new path machinery.

implementation.engine_reuse: Add a module-name suggestion variant in internal/importhint (same package as levenshtein at :103 — reuse it directly, no re-implementation).
